decision_summary: The WalkBuddy ML team unanimously approved this first structurally valid eight-class navigation model as the production default after review of the bound evidence and final physical-device acceptance. This is an explicit human decision, not an automatic comparison PASS.
accepted_limitations: Pole is the weakest class in the labelled validation evidence and remains recall-limited, particularly for small and extreme-geometry boxes.
The historical seven-class baseline is taxonomy-incompatible and cannot be used for automatic pass/fail comparison of this first eight-class model.
